descFull: Kodachi OS is a Debian-based privacy & security OS by Warith Al Maawali, built for uncompromising privacy, anonymity, and reliability. It pairs hardened defaults with a curated toolkit for private browsing, advanced networking, and incident response, all in an intuitive interface.
